At Fate's End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love, and your skill tree is your family tree. Wield the legendary God Sword Aesus as Shan, the deft young heiress of the Hemlock clan. Solve intricate narrative puzzles, uncover painful truths, and hone both your blade skills and knowledge to face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels - and ultimately decide your family’s fate.

description:
All bets are off when Battlefield 6 Season 5 hits Las Vegas on October 13.

Throughout Season 5, battle across three new maps, including Vegas Strip and Area 51, from casinos and rooftops to open desert and secret underground tunnels. Expand your arsenal with six new weapons and two new vehicles, take on Operation High Roller, climb the MP Leaderboards, form Platoons, and return to updated Blackwell Fields and New Sobek City.

The fight continues in REDSEC with Rapid Royale, a new free-to-play mode built for faster, more aggressive Battle Royale. Get kills. Earn redeploys. Fight to the top. Plus, Ranked Battle Royale officially launches alongside the Open Series.

Then face something more sinister in the limited-time Halloween event.

The house always wins. Until now.
